__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRES
__inputs.label: PostgreSQL (Score DB)
__inputs.description: PostgreSQL datasource — public schema, Score microservice

description: DDM Business Dashboard — Health, Quality, Retention, Content, Gamification, Coin Economy

panels.title: DAU (Identified Users)
panels.description: تعداد کاربران یونیک شناسایی‌شده در روز. anonymous events حذف شده‌اند.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, uniqExact(user_id) AS dau FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 1 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Watch Hours + Avg Min/User
panels.description: کل ساعت تماشا و میانگین دقیقه به ازای هر کاربر

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, round(sum(watch_duration) / 3600.0) AS total_hours, round((sum(watch_duration) / 60.0) / uniqExact(user_id), 1) AS avg_min_per_user FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration BETWEEN 10 AND 14400 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS dau FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 1 AND created_at >= toStartOfDay(now())
SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS mau FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY

panels.title: Stickiness % (DAU/MAU)
panels.description: هدف >20% (benchmark صنعت ویدیو)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= toStartOfDay(now())) / uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY), 1) AS stickiness FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10

panels.title: Anonymous Ratio %
panels.description: گپ instrumentation — کاربران بدون شناسه

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100 * countIf(user_id = '' OR user_id = 'total') / count(), 1) AS anonymous_pct FROM stats.watch_events WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: Watch Quality (Bounce / Short / Engaged)
panels.description: Bounce <10s | Short 10-60s | Engaged >60s — هدف Engaged >30%

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, round(100 * countIf(watch_duration < 10) / count(), 1) AS bounce_pct, round(100 * countIf(watch_duration BETWEEN 10 AND 60) / count(), 1) AS short_pct, round(100 * countIf(watch_duration > 60) / count(), 1) AS engaged_pct FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration BETWEEN 1 AND 14400 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Avg Session Length per via
panels.description: VOD باید بالاتر، UGC پایین‌تر — رفتار طبیعی محصول

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(via=1,'1-VOD',via=2,'2-Vlog',via=3,'3-Cinema',via=4,'4-TV',via=5,'5-UGC',toString(via)) AS product, round(avg(watch_duration)) AS avg_sec, quantile(0.5)(watch_duration) AS median_sec FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration BETWEEN 1 AND 14400 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY product ORDER BY product

panels.title: Watch Hours per via (weekly)
panels.description: ساعت تماشای هفتگی به تفکیک محصول (VOD/Vlog/Cinema/TV/UGC) — stacked bars

targets.rawSql: SELECT toMonday(created_at) AS time, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=1) / 3600.0) AS VOD, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=2) / 3600.0) AS Vlog, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=3) / 3600.0) AS Cinema, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=4) / 3600.0) AS TV, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=5) / 3600.0) AS UGC FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration BETWEEN 10 AND 14400 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: App × ISP Matrix (30d)
panels.description: ترکیب پلتفرم و اپراتور — تمرکز سرمایه‌گذاری

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(app=1,'1-Android',app=2,'2-Web',app=3,'3-Rubika',app=4,'4-Splus',toString(app)) AS app_name, multiIf(isp=1,'1-MCI',isp=2,'2-Irancell',isp=3,'3-Others',toString(isp)) AS isp_name, uniqExact(user_id) AS users, round(sum(watch_duration) / 3600.0) AS hours FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY app_name, isp_name ORDER BY users DESC

panels.title: Weekly Cohort Retention (D1 / D7 / D30)
panels.description: Classic retention (single-day) — D1/D7/D30 = % کاربر فعال دقیقاً روز N. Target: D1≈28-30, D7≈18-20, D30≈10-12

targets.rawSql: WITH cohort AS (  SELECT user_id, min(toDate(created_at)) AS install_day   FROM stats.watch_events   WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total'   GROUP BY user_id), activity AS (  SELECT we.user_id, c.install_day,          dateDiff('day', c.install_day, toDate(we.created_at)) AS day_n   FROM stats.watch_events we   INNER JOIN cohort c ON we.user_id = c.user_id   WHERE we.user_id != '' AND we.user_id != 'total'     AND we.watch_duration >= 10     AND c.install_day >= today() - 90     AND c.install_day < today() - 30) SELECT toMonday(install_day) AS cohort_week,        uniqExact(user_id) AS cohort_size,        round(100 * uniqExactIf(user_id, day_n = 1) / uniqExact(user_id), 1) AS d1_pct,        round(100 * uniqExactIf(user_id, day_n = 7) / uniqExact(user_id), 1) AS d7_pct,        round(100 * uniqExactIf(user_id, day_n = 30) / uniqExact(user_id), 1) AS d30_pct FROM activity GROUP BY cohort_week ORDER BY cohort_week DESC

panels.title: Top 30 Content (last 7d)
panels.description: محتواهای پربازدید — اگر top 10 سهم >50% کل watch، تنوع کم است

targets.rawSql: SELECT content_title, multiIf(via=1,'VOD',via=2,'Vlog',via=3,'Cinema',via=4,'TV',via=5,'UGC',toString(via)) AS product, uniqExact(user_id) AS viewers, round(sum(watch_duration) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours, round(avg(watch_duration)) AS avg_sec FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND content_title != '' GROUP BY content_title, product ORDER BY hours DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: VOD Cleanup Candidates (30d)
panels.description: VOD‌هایی که سن‌شون ≥۳۰ روزه ولی در ۳۰ روز اخیر <۵۰ یونیک viewer داشتن. مرتب‌شده بر اساس کم‌بازدیدترین. ⚠️ گروه‌بندی بر content_title — اگر دو ویدیو هم‌اسم باشن، ادغام می‌شن.

targets.rawSql: WITH content_stats AS (SELECT content_title, min(toDate(created_at)) AS first_seen, uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS viewers_30d, round(sumIf(watch_duration, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours_30d, round(avgIf(watch_duration, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND watch_duration >= 10)) AS avg_sec_30d, round(100 * countIf(watch_duration < 10 AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) / nullIf(countIf(created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY), 0), 1) AS bounce_pct_30d FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND content_title != '' AND via = 1 AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 120 DAY GROUP BY content_title) SELECT content_title, first_seen, viewers_30d, hours_30d, avg_sec_30d, bounce_pct_30d FROM content_stats WHERE first_seen <= today() - 30 AND viewers_30d < 50 ORDER BY viewers_30d ASC, hours_30d ASC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Gamified DAU
panels.description: کاربری که اکشن امتیازآور انجام داده — مقایسه با Watch DAU

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(created_at)) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_did) AS gamified_dau FROM public.detail_scores WHERE created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() AND channel_did IS NOT NULL AND channel_did != '' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Scoring Actions Breakdown (30d)
panels.description: اکشن‌های امتیازآور — Source: settings.go LIKE_ACTION..VERSION_ACTION

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE action WHEN 1 THEN 'Like' WHEN 2 THEN 'Comment' WHEN 3 THEN 'Watch' WHEN 4 THEN 'Invite' WHEN 5 THEN 'Subscribe' WHEN 6 THEN 'DailyVisit' WHEN 7 THEN 'CompleteProfile' WHEN 8 THEN 'Spinner' WHEN 9 THEN 'FirstLogin' WHEN 10 THEN 'Market' WHEN 11 THEN 'Medal' WHEN 12 THEN 'GotView' WHEN 13 THEN 'GotLiked' WHEN 14 THEN 'OpenLink' WHEN 15 THEN 'Upload' WHEN 16 THEN 'Claim' WHEN 17 THEN 'Version' ELSE action::text END AS action_name, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_did) AS users, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(score) AS total_score FROM public.detail_scores WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(created_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY action ORDER BY events DESC

panels.title: Coin Economy (In / Out / Net)
panels.description: اگر net_flow پایدار مثبت = تورم سکه | منفی = اقتصاد سالم

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TO_TIMESTAMP(created_at)) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS coin_in, SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS coin_out, SUM(amount) AS net_flow FROM public.user_coin_history WHERE created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Reward Funnel (All Time)
panels.description: 1=Failed 2=Waiting 3=Accepted 4=Sending 5=Taken 6=CanceledByUser 7=CanceledByAdmin 8=Draft. Snapshot وضعیت فعلی هر reward — کل تاریخ.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '1-Failed' WHEN 2 THEN '2-Waiting' WHEN 3 THEN '3-Accepted' WHEN 4 THEN '4-Sending' WHEN 5 THEN '5-Taken' WHEN 6 THEN '6-CanceledByUser' WHEN 7 THEN '7-CanceledByAdmin' WHEN 8 THEN '8-Draft' ELSE status::text END AS status_name, COUNT(*) AS reward_count, COUNT(DISTINCT channel_did) AS unique_users FROM public.user_rewards GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Battle Pass — Last 6 Seasons
panels.description: participants/MAU = engagement Battle Pass | finishers/participants = نرخ تکمیل (FINAL=70k)

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.id AS season_id, s.name, TO_TIMESTAMP(s."from")::date AS start_date, TO_TIMESTAMP(s."to")::date AS end_date, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.channel_did) AS participants, ROUND(AVG(ss.score)) AS avg_score, MAX(ss.score) AS max_score, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ss.score >= 70000 THEN ss.channel_did END) AS finishers FROM public.seasons s LEFT JOIN public.season_scores ss ON s.id = ss.season_id WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(s."from") >= NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days' GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s."from", s."to" ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 6

panels.title: Battle Pass Progression — Current Season
panels.description: شکل قیف Battle Pass — اگر اکثر کاربران در bucket پایین، discover ضعیف است

targets.rawSql: WITH current_season AS (SELECT id FROM public.seasons WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP("from") <= NOW() AND TO_TIMESTAMP("to") >= NOW() ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT CASE WHEN score < 500 THEN '0-500' WHEN score < 1500 THEN '500-1.5k' WHEN score < 7000 THEN '1.5k-7k' WHEN score < 30000 THEN '7k-30k' WHEN score < 70000 THEN '30k-70k (step 9-10)' WHEN score < 100000 THEN 'FINAL' ELSE 'OVERLOAD' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS users FROM public.season_scores ss JOIN current_season cs ON ss.season_id = cs.id GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(score)

panels.title: Coin Sources & Sinks per Type (30d)
panels.description: تفکیک هر کانال earn/spend سکه — اقتصاد سالم = sinks بزرگ‌تر از sources organic

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE type WHEN 1 THEN 'EARN DailyLogin' WHEN 2 THEN 'EARN Spinner' WHEN 3 THEN 'EARN Claim(BP/Lvl/Mission)' WHEN 4 THEN 'EARN Admin' WHEN 5 THEN 'EARN Box' WHEN 6 THEN 'EARN BuyCoin' WHEN 7 THEN 'EARN CancelRefundUser' WHEN 8 THEN 'EARN CancelRefundAdmin' WHEN 9 THEN 'EARN ReceiveTransfer' WHEN 10 THEN 'SPEND SendTransfer' WHEN 11 THEN 'SPEND ShopReward' WHEN 12 THEN 'SPEND Lottery' WHEN 13 THEN 'SPEND Ticket' WHEN 14 THEN 'SPEND Profile' WHEN 15 THEN 'SPEND ReSpin' WHEN 16 THEN 'EARN Leaderboard' WHEN 17 THEN 'SYS Force' ELSE type::text END AS bucket, SUM(amount)::bigint AS net_amount, COUNT(*) AS txns FROM public.user_coin_history WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(created_at) >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY type ORDER BY ABS(SUM(amount)) DESC

panels.title: Daily Activations — Paid vs Voucher
panels.description: تومان | فیلتر: platform=didimoon، status=موفق، بدون test.sandbox

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(up.created_at)) AS time, CASE WHEN up.amount = 0 THEN 'Voucher Activated' WHEN p.type = 1 THEN 'Subscription Paid' WHEN p.type = 2 THEN 'Coin Pack Paid' ELSE 'Other' END AS product, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_price p ON up.price_id = p.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time, product ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top 5 Plans by Revenue (current period)
panels.description: کدوم پلن بیشترین درآمد رو میاره

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS plan, COUNT(*) AS payments, SUM(up.amount) AS revenue FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_price p ON up.price_id = p.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Revenue by Gateway
panels.description: سهم درگاه‌ها — مهم: cafebazaar 30٪ کمیسیون می‌گیره

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.name AS gateway, SUM(up.amount) AS revenue FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_gateway g ON up.gateway_id = g.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.gateway_id IS NOT NULL AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY g.id, g.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

panels.title: Payment Success Rate % (Active Attempts)
panels.description: Active Attempt Conversion = SUCCESS / (SUCCESS + IN-FLIGHT + FAILURE). Success: 40,41,42,43,44. In-flight: 11,13,21 (PENDING/IN_PROGRESS). Failure: 31,32,53,54. حذف: DRAFT (12) — فقط کنجکاوی، و admin (51,52). هدف >70% — اگه پایین = abandonment وسط فرایند یا گیت‌وی ضعیف.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(created_at)) AS time, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (40, 41, 42, 43, 44) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 11, 13, 21, 31, 32, 53, 54) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS success_pct FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() AND status IN (40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 11, 13, 21, 31, 32, 53, 54) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: 30d Snapshot
panels.description: Revenue، Payers، ARPPU

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS payments, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_payers, ROUND(SUM(amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)) AS arppu, ROUND(AVG(amount)) AS aov FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)

panels.title: Whale Concentration (last 90d)
panels.description: تعداد خرید per user — اگر max خیلی بزرگ، اقتصاد به چند نفر وابسته

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(spend) AS total_spend FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(amount) AS spend, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '1 خرید (one-time)' WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4 خرید (casual)' WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 5 AND 9 THEN '5-9 خرید (regular)' WHEN COUNT(*) BETWEEN 10 AND 19 THEN '10-19 خرید (heavy)' ELSE '20+ خرید (whale)' END AS bucket FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY user_id) t GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(cnt)

panels.title: Cross-Source: Payers Coverage
panels.description: چند درصد payerها profile_id (channelDid) دارند برای join با ClickHouse/Score

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Total Payers' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS value FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT 'With profile_id (joinable)', COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.profile_id IS NOT NULL AND up.profile_id != '' AND up.created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT 'Without profile_id (orphan)', COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details, '$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND (up.profile_id IS NULL OR up.profile_id = '') AND up.created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)

panels.title: Checkout Funnel (90d)
panels.description: DRAFT → ACTIVE: نرخ تکمیل پرداخت. هدف >40%، الان ~9.5% — leak اصلی revenue

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE status WHEN 11 THEN '1-PENDING' WHEN 12 THEN '2-DRAFT' WHEN 13 THEN '3-PENDING_CONFIRM' WHEN 21 THEN '4-IN_PROGRESS' WHEN 31 THEN '5-FAILED' WHEN 32 THEN '6-FAIL_QUEUE' WHEN 41 THEN '7-ACTIVE_PAID' WHEN 40 THEN '8-ACTIVE_INVISIBLE' WHEN 42 THEN '9-PUBLISHED' WHEN 43 THEN '10-CONVERTED' WHEN 44 THEN '11-ACCEPTED' WHEN 51 THEN '12-DISABLED' WHEN 52 THEN '13-DELETED' WHEN 53 THEN '14-REJECTED' WHEN 54 THEN '15-EXPIRE' ELSE CONCAT('?-', status) END AS stage, COUNT(*) AS attempts FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

panels.title: Real Monthly KPIs (30d)
panels.description: Revenue واقعی + Paying Users + ARPPU + Voucher Activated

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND status = 41 AND amount > 0 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS net_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND status = 41 AND amount > 0 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS paid_txns, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND status = 41 AND amount > 0 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS paid_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND status = 41 AND amount = 0 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS voucher_activated, (SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), 0)) FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND status = 41 AND amount > 0 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS arppu

panels.title: VOD Cleanup Candidates (30d) — کاندیدای حذف
panels.description: محتوای VOD که ≥۳۰ روز روی پلتفرم بوده و در ۳۰ روز اخیر عملکرد ضعیف داشته. Action: viewers_30d <50 یا hours_30d <5 → بررسی برای حذف. bounce_pct >60 → thumbnail/title فریب‌دهنده یا ویدیو خراب.

targets.rawSql: WITH content_stats AS (  SELECT content_title,          min(toDate(created_at)) AS first_seen,          uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AS viewers_30d,          round(sumIf(watch_duration, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)/3600.0, 1) AS hours_30d,          round(avgIf(watch_duration, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS avg_sec_30d,          round(100 * countIf(watch_duration < 10 AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)                    / nullIf(countIf(created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY), 0), 1) AS bounce_pct_30d   FROM stats.watch_events   WHERE via = 1     AND user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total'     AND content_title != ''     AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 120 DAY   GROUP BY content_title) SELECT content_title, first_seen, viewers_30d, hours_30d, avg_sec_30d, bounce_pct_30d FROM content_stats WHERE first_seen <= today() - 30   AND (viewers_30d < 50 OR hours_30d < 5) ORDER BY viewers_30d ASC, hours_30d ASC LIMIT 200

panels.title: New Users / Day — first-seen (با baseline ۳۰ روزه)
panels.description: کاربر جدید = اولین created_at در stats.watch_events با watch_duration ≥ ۱۰s. ترکیب signup + اولین فعالیت معنادار. baseline = میانگین ۳۰ روز قبلی (rolling).

targets.rawSql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(MIN(created_at)) AS first_day FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 GROUP BY user_id), daily AS (SELECT first_day AS day, count() AS new_users FROM first_seen WHERE first_day >= toDate(now()) - INTERVAL 180 DAY GROUP BY first_day) SELECT toDateTime(day) AS time, new_users, round(avg(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) AS baseline_30d FROM daily WHERE $__timeFilter(toDateTime(day)) ORDER BY day

WITH first_seen AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(MIN(created_at)) AS first_day FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND created_at >= toDate(now()) - INTERVAL 60 DAY GROUP BY user_id) SELECT count() AS new_users_today FROM first_seen WHERE first_day = toDate(now())

panels.title: Last 7d Avg vs 30d Baseline — Lift %
panels.description: اگر >۰: رشد. <۰: افت. منطقی >۱۰٪ یعنی اتفاقی افتاده (کمپین، event، یا انتشار جدید).

targets.rawSql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(MIN(created_at)) AS first_day FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND created_at >= toDate(now()) - INTERVAL 60 DAY GROUP BY user_id), daily AS (SELECT first_day AS day, count() AS cnt FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day) SELECT round(100 * (avgIf(cnt, day >= toDate(now()) - 7 AND day < toDate(now())) - avgIf(cnt, day >= toDate(now()) - 37 AND day < toDate(now()) - 7)) / nullIf(avgIf(cnt, day >= toDate(now()) - 37 AND day < toDate(now()) - 7), 0), 1) AS lift_pct FROM daily

panels.title: New Users — Daily Breakdown (last 45d)
panels.description: جدول روزانه با مقایسه vs میانگین ۳۰ روز قبل. ستون lift_pct سیگنال کمپین، event، یا spike.

targets.rawSql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT user_id, toDate(MIN(created_at)) AS first_day FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND created_at >= toDate(now()) - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY user_id), daily AS (SELECT first_day AS day, count() AS new_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day), with_baseline AS (SELECT day, new_users, round(avg(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)) AS baseline_30d FROM daily) SELECT day, new_users, baseline_30d, round(100 * (new_users - baseline_30d) / nullIf(baseline_30d, 0), 1) AS lift_pct FROM with_baseline WHERE day >= toDate(now()) - 45 ORDER BY day DESC
